items.name: addAzureKubernetesEnvironment
items.description: Adds an Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environment to the distributed application. This provisions an AKS cluster and configures it as a Kubernetes compute environment.
items.remarks:

and provisions an AKS cluster via Azure Bicep. It combines the functionality of
`AddKubernetesEnvironment` with Azure-specific provisioning.

items.name: addHelmChart
items.description: Adds an external Helm chart to be installed in the AKS environment's inner Kubernetes environment. The chart is installed via `helm upgrade --install` as a pipeline step after the main application Helm chart is deployed.
items.remarks:
This method delegates to the inner `KubernetesEnvironmentResource` of the AKS
environment, so the returned `KubernetesHelmChartResource` can be configured
with the same `WithHelmValue`,
`WithNamespace`,
`WithReleaseName`, and
`WithDestroy` extensions used with
non-AKS Kubernetes environments.
External Helm charts are not uninstalled by `aspire destroy` by default,
because they may be shared with workloads outside the Aspire app. Opt in by chaining
`WithDestroy`.
items.returns: A resource builder for the Helm chart resource.
